title: Xenosaga Episode III arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2006, Xenosaga Episode III became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2006, Xenosaga Episode III became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the role-playing category, Xenosaga Episode III broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
